name: Bold
description: Transform your text into bold Unicode characters that work everywhere
content: Bold Unicode text uses characters from the Mathematical Sans-Serif Bold block (U+1D5D4–U+1D607). These characters look bold in any text field because they are actual Unicode code points, not formatting. They work on social media bios, messaging apps, and anywhere that accepts text input.
tips: Bold text is perfect for making headlines, usernames, or key words stand out in social media posts. It works on Instagram bios, Twitter/X posts, Facebook comments, and Discord messages without any special app.

name: Italic
description: Convert text to italic Unicode characters for elegant styling
content: Italic Unicode text uses Mathematical Sans-Serif Italic characters (U+1D608–U+1D63B). These render as slanted text in any text field without needing formatting support. Perfect for emphasis, titles, and artistic text.
tips: Use italic text to add emphasis or an elegant touch to your social media posts. Great for quotes, book titles, or stylistic flourishes in bios.

name: Bold Italic
description: Combine bold and italic styling in Unicode text
content: Bold Italic Unicode uses Mathematical Sans-Serif Bold Italic characters (U+1D63C–U+1D66F). These combine the weight of bold with the slant of italic for maximum emphasis. They render consistently across all platforms.
tips: Bold italic is great for maximum emphasis — use it sparingly for headings or important announcements in your posts.

name: Monospace
description: Transform text into monospace/typewriter style Unicode characters
content: Monospace Unicode uses Mathematical Monospace characters (U+1D670–U+1D6A3). Every character takes the same width, creating a typewriter or code-like appearance. Perfect for technical content or retro aesthetics.
tips: Monospace text gives a technical, coder vibe. Use it for code snippets, technical usernames, or to create a retro typewriter look in your posts.

name: Cursive
description: Generate flowing cursive/script Unicode text
content: Cursive Unicode uses Mathematical Script characters (U+1D49C–U+1D4CF). These flowing, handwritten-style characters add elegance and personality to any text. Some characters have alternate forms for visual variety.
tips: Cursive text is one of the most popular font styles for Instagram bios and display names. It adds a personal, handwritten touch that stands out.

name: Cursive Bold
description: Bold script/cursive Unicode text with extra weight
content: Bold Cursive uses Mathematical Bold Script characters (U+1D4D0–U+1D503). These combine the elegance of script with the weight of bold for a dramatic, eye-catching effect.
tips: Bold cursive makes an even bigger visual impact than regular cursive. Perfect for display names, headings, or special announcements.

name: Old English
description: Gothic/Fraktur style Unicode text with medieval character
content: Old English/Fraktur Unicode uses Mathematical Fraktur characters (U+1D504–U+1D537). These blackletter-style characters evoke medieval manuscripts and gothic aesthetics. Popular in gaming communities and alternative culture.
tips: Old English text is popular for gaming usernames, metal band aesthetics, and gothic-themed content. It makes any text look ancient and powerful.

name: Old English Bold
description: Bold gothic/fraktur style Unicode text
content: Bold Fraktur Unicode uses Mathematical Bold Fraktur characters (U+1D56C–U+1D59F). These are thicker versions of the gothic/blackletter characters, making them even more dramatic and visible.
tips: Bold Old English is even more dramatic than the regular version. Perfect for display names or when you want maximum medieval impact.

name: Double-Struck
description: Outlined/double-lined Unicode text with a unique look
content: Double-Struck (Blackboard Bold) uses Mathematical Double-Struck characters (U+1D538–U+1D56B). Originally used in mathematics to denote number sets (like ℝ for real numbers), these outlined characters create a distinctive hollow look.
tips: Double-struck text has a unique, mathematical aesthetic. Great for academic-themed content, unique usernames, or standing out with a different look.

name: Bold Serif
description: Classic bold serif style Unicode text
content: Bold Serif uses Mathematical Bold characters (U+1D400–U+1D433). These are the classic bold letterforms with serifs, giving a traditional, authoritative appearance similar to newspaper headlines.
tips: Bold serif text has a classic, authoritative look — perfect for formal announcements or when you want a newspaper-headline feel.

name: Italic Serif
description: Classic italic serif style Unicode text
content: Italic Serif uses Mathematical Italic characters (U+1D434–U+1D467). These are traditional italic letterforms with serifs, evoking classical typography and elegance.
tips: Italic serif gives a literary, classical feel. Great for quotes, book references, or adding traditional elegance to your text.

name: Bold Italic Serif
description: Combined bold italic serif Unicode text
content: Bold Italic Serif uses Mathematical Bold Italic characters (U+1D468–U+1D49B). These combine the weight of bold with the slant of italic in a classic serif style.
tips: Bold italic serif is the most emphatic traditional text style. Use for maximum impact in a classical typography context.

name: Circled
description: Letters enclosed in circles for a bubble-like effect
content: Circled letters use Unicode Enclosed Alphanumerics (U+24B6–U+24E9). Each letter appears inside a circle, creating a bubble or badge-like effect. These are great for list markers, decorative text, and unique styling.
tips: Circled text is eye-catching and works great for numbered lists, labels, or decorative social media posts. Each character looks like a small badge.

name: Negative Circled
description: White letters on dark circle backgrounds
content: Negative Circled letters use Unicode Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement characters (U+1F150–U+1F169 for uppercase). These show white letters on dark filled circles, creating a high-contrast badge effect.
tips: Negative circled text is very eye-catching with its filled dark circles. Only uppercase letters are available in this style.

name: Squared
description: Letters enclosed in squares for a badge/button look
content: Squared letters use Unicode Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement characters (U+1F130–U+1F149). Each uppercase letter appears inside a square, creating a button or keyboard-key appearance.
tips: Squared text looks like keyboard keys or buttons. Only uppercase letters are available. Great for emphasis or creating a technical look.

name: Negative Squared
description: White letters on dark square backgrounds
content: Negative Squared letters use Unicode Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement characters (U+1F170–U+1F189). These show white letters on dark filled squares, creating high-visibility block text.
tips: Negative squared text is one of the most visible Unicode styles. Only uppercase letters work. Perfect for important announcements or headings.

name: Fullwidth
description: Wide spaced text using fullwidth Unicode characters
content: Fullwidth characters use Unicode Halfwidth and Fullwidth Forms (U+FF01–U+FF5E). Originally designed for East Asian typography where Latin characters needed to match CJK character width. Now popular for aesthetic/vaporwave styling.
tips: Fullwidth text has that distinctive a e s t h e t i c / vaporwave look. It takes up more horizontal space, making text appear wider and more dramatic.

name: Small Caps
description: Lowercase letters rendered as small uppercase characters
content: Small Caps use various Unicode blocks including Latin Extended and Phonetic Extensions to create lowercase-sized uppercase letters. This typography style is used in formal documents, headings, and gives text a refined, professional appearance.
tips: Small caps text looks professional and clean — perfect for LinkedIn profiles, headers, or when you want a subtle but distinctive style.

name: Superscript
description: Tiny raised text using superscript Unicode characters
content: Superscript text uses Unicode Superscript characters from various blocks including Superscripts and Subscripts (U+2070–U+209F) and Phonetic Extensions. These tiny raised characters appear above the baseline.
tips: Superscript text is one of the most popular 'small text' styles. It creates a whispering or footnote effect that's great for secondary information or aesthetic posts.

name: Subscript
description: Tiny lowered text using subscript Unicode characters
content: Subscript text uses Unicode Subscript characters (U+2080–U+209C). These lowered characters appear below the baseline. Note: not all letters have subscript versions in Unicode.
tips: Subscript has limited character coverage — some letters will appear normal. Best for short text or numbers where the available characters work.

name: Upside Down
description: Flip your text upside down using rotated Unicode characters
content: Upside down text uses various Unicode characters that visually resemble flipped Latin letters. The text is also reversed left-to-right to read correctly when the screen is turned upside down. Uses characters from IPA Extensions, Latin Extended, and mathematical symbols.
tips: Upside down text is fun for pranks, jokes, or creative posts. The text reads correctly when you flip your screen upside down!

name: Bubble
description: Text with circled/bubble letters for a fun rounded look
content: Bubble text uses Unicode Enclosed Alphanumerics, which place each character inside a circle. This creates a playful, rounded appearance that's perfect for casual, fun content.
tips: Bubble text is great for fun, playful posts. Works for both uppercase and lowercase letters, giving your text a lighthearted bubbly feel.

name: Parenthesized
description: Letters wrapped in parentheses for a labeled look
content: Parenthesized text uses Unicode Enclosed Alphanumerics (U+249C–U+24B5) for lowercase letters. Each character appears wrapped in parentheses, creating a labeled or annotated appearance.
tips: Parenthesized text has a unique annotated look. Only lowercase letters are available. Good for creating labeled or indexed-looking text.

name: Underline
description: Add underline to any text using combining Unicode characters
content: Underlined text uses the Unicode Combining Low Line character (U+0332) placed after each character. This creates an underline effect that works anywhere, even in plain text fields that don't support formatting.
tips: Underline text works everywhere because it uses combining characters. Great for emphasis, links that aren't clickable, or recreating a typed/official document look.

name: Double Underline
description: Add double underline to text using combining characters
content: Double Underlined text uses the Unicode Combining Double Low Line character (U+0333). This adds two lines beneath each character for extra emphasis.
tips: Double underline creates a stronger emphasis than single underline. Use when you really want to highlight important text.

name: Strikethrough
description: Cross out text with a line through each character
content: Strikethrough text uses the Unicode Combining Long Stroke Overlay character (U+0336). This draws a horizontal line through each character, commonly used to show deleted or corrected text.
tips: Strikethrough is perfect for humor (showing what you 'really' think), corrections, or indicating deleted/outdated information in posts.

name: Slash Through
description: Text with a diagonal slash through each character
content: Slash-through text uses the Unicode Combining Long Solidus Overlay character (U+0338). This places a diagonal line through each character, creating a different crossing-out effect than horizontal strikethrough.
tips: Slash-through is more dramatic than regular strikethrough. It creates a 'censored' or 'forbidden' look that draws attention.

name: Wavy
description: Text with a wavy line underneath each character
content: Wavy text uses the Unicode Combining Tilde Below character (U+0330). This adds a small wavy/tilde mark beneath each character, creating a playful or spooky effect.
tips: Wavy text adds a subtle mysterious or playful quality. The tilde marks below create an ethereal or ghostly vibe.

name: Dotted
description: Text with dots above each character
content: Dotted text uses the Unicode Combining Dot Above character (U+0307). This places a small dot above each character, creating a distinctive dotted or snowy appearance.
tips: Dotted text looks like snow falling or stars above your text. Creates a subtle but noticeable decorative effect.

name: Wide Spaced
description: Add extra space between each character for an aesthetic look
preview: T h e   q u i c k   b r o w n   f o x
content: Wide spaced text simply inserts a space (or other separator) between each character of your input text. This creates a stretched-out, aesthetic look that's associated with vaporwave and minimalist design.
tips: Wide spaced text is simple but effective for creating an aesthetic or dramatic effect. Works everywhere since it's just regular characters with spaces.

name: Inverted
description: Reversed/mirrored text that reads backwards
content: Inverted/mirrored text uses various Unicode characters that visually resemble mirrored Latin letters. The text is also reversed in order so it appears to read backwards, like in a mirror.
tips: Mirror text is fun for secret messages, puzzles, or creating an Alice-in-Wonderland effect. Hold your phone to a mirror to read it!

name: Reversed
description: Simply reverse the order of characters in your text
content: Reversed text simply flips the order of all characters in your input. Unlike mirror text, it uses the same characters but in reverse sequence. Simple but effective for fun and games.
tips: Reversed text is the simplest transformation — just the characters in opposite order. Great for word games and puzzles.

name: Medieval
description: Ancient-looking text mixing various Unicode characters
content: Medieval-style text uses characters from Latin Extended-B, Latin Extended Additional, and other Unicode blocks. These modified Latin characters with strokes, hooks, and bars create an ancient or Nordic appearance.
tips: Medieval text is great for RPG games, fantasy-themed content, or Norse/Viking aesthetics. Creates an authentic ancient manuscript feel.

name: Currency
description: Transform letters into currency-like symbols
content: Currency text replaces letters with currency symbols and related Unicode characters (₮, €, ¢, ₹, ₩, etc.). Creates a money/finance-themed text style.
tips: Currency text is fun for finance-related posts, money talk, or creating a 'rich' aesthetic. Not all letters have perfect currency equivalents.

name: Greek Style
description: Text styled with Greek-looking characters
content: Greek-style text uses a mix of actual Greek letters and modified Latin characters that resemble Greek typography. Creates a fraternity/sorority or ancient Greek aesthetic.
tips: Greek-style text is perfect for fraternity/sorority content, academic aesthetics, or giving your text a philosophical, classical Greek feel.

name: Dots Around
description: Surround each character with dots above and below
content: This style adds combining arrow marks to each character using Unicode Combining Right Arrow Above (U+20D7). Creates a directional or motion-like effect on your text.
tips: Arrow-decorated text creates a sense of motion or direction. Subtle but distinctive decoration for your posts.

name: Crossed
description: Add an X mark above each character
content: Crossed text uses the Unicode Combining X Above character (U+033D). This places a small X mark above each character for a unique decorative effect.
tips: The X marks above create a 'kisses' (xoxo) or 'crossed out' aesthetic. Subtle and unusual decoration.

name: Sparkle
description: Add sparkle/star marks above each character
content: Sparkle text uses the Unicode Combining Asterisk Above character (U+20F0). This adds a tiny star/asterisk above each character, creating a sparkling or glittering effect.
tips: Sparkle text adds a magical, glittery quality to your posts. Perfect for celebrations, positivity, or aesthetic content.

name: Hearts Between
description: Insert heart symbols between each character
content: Hearts Between text inserts a heart symbol (♥) between each character in your text. Simple but effective for expressing love, affection, or cute aesthetics.
tips: Hearts between letters is perfect for Valentine's messages, expressing love, or adding a cute touch to any text.

name: Stars Between
description: Insert star symbols between each character
content: Stars Between text inserts a filled star symbol (★) between each character. Creates a starry, magical, or rating-like appearance.
tips: Stars between letters creates a sparkly, magical effect. Great for celebrations, reviews, or emphasizing something special.

name: Dots Between
description: Insert dots/bullets between each character
content: Dots Between text inserts a bullet point (•) between each character. Creates a clean, separated, rhythmic look popular in professional and aesthetic content.
tips: Dots between letters create a clean, aesthetic spacing effect. Popular for Instagram bios and professional-looking text styling.

name: Box Brackets
description: Wrap each word in decorative box brackets
content: Box Bracket text wraps each character in CJK (Chinese-Japanese-Korean) corner brackets 【】. These fullwidth brackets create a dramatic, anime-inspired or gaming-style text.
tips: Box brackets give text a Japanese/anime-inspired look. Very popular in gaming communities and for dramatic effect.

name: Angle Brackets
description: Wrap each character in angle bracket decorations
content: Angle Bracket text wraps each character in Unicode tortoise shell brackets 〖〗. These create a technical, manga-styled or game interface appearance.
tips: Tortoise shell brackets create a futuristic, tech-style appearance. Great for sci-fi themed content or gaming.

name: Double Parentheses
description: Wrap each character in double parentheses
content: Double Parentheses text uses Unicode Left and Right Double Parenthesis characters (U+2E28, U+2E29) to wrap each letter. Creates a formal, enclosed appearance.
tips: Double parentheses create a formal, document-like appearance. Unique and rarely seen style that stands out.

name: Runic Style
description: Text resembling ancient runes using various Unicode characters
content: Runic-style text uses characters from the Yi Syllables and other Unicode blocks that visually resemble ancient runes and mystical scripts. While not actual runes, they create a similar mysterious aesthetic.
tips: Runic text is perfect for fantasy RPG gaming, Norse mythology content, or creating mysterious-looking text. Very popular in gaming communities.

name: Symbol Art
description: Replace letters with various decorative symbols
content: Symbol Art text replaces letters with astrological and miscellaneous symbols from Unicode. While not readable as text, it creates an artistic, coded appearance inspired by Wingdings-style fonts.
tips: Symbol art creates a decorative, encoded look. More artistic than readable — perfect for aesthetic decoration or mystery themes.

name: Lenticular Brackets
description: Wrap characters in lenticular bracket pairs
content: Lenticular Bracket text uses CJK Left and Right Corner Brackets (「」) to wrap each character. These single-width brackets are used in Japanese and Chinese text for quotation, creating a clean Asian typography aesthetic.
tips: Lenticular brackets give a clean Japanese manga-style look. Very popular in anime and Japanese culture aesthetics.

name: Black Squares
description: Characters surrounded by black square decorations
content: Black Squares text inserts black medium square symbols (◼) between characters. Creates a bold, rhythmic, block-style appearance.
tips: Black squares create a strong visual rhythm in your text. Bold and dramatic — great for attention-grabbing posts.

name: Diamonds Between
description: Insert diamond shapes between each character
content: Diamonds Between text inserts black diamond shapes (◆) between each character. Creates an elegant, decorative appearance with geometric shapes.
tips: Diamonds add an elegant geometric touch between letters. Clean and decorative for profile bios or special posts.

name: Tildes Between
description: Insert tilde symbols between characters for a wavy separator
content: Tildes Between text inserts tilde characters (~) between each letter. The tilde creates a wave-like separation that's casual, playful, and associated with internet culture and aesthetic posts.
tips: Tildes between letters create a casual, internet-culture aesthetic (~like~this~). Popular on Tumblr and aesthetic social media.
